name: before-ruling-16-window-listed-first-would-change-a-held-key
reference: spec 0.52 ruling 16: the bits of a `when ... as <k>` line whose key the entity holds count as bits that key wrote; later is the order of settling: the window settles after the plain `when` wrote 0x10 for x = 16, and would change its low nibble 0 to 5
